headline: CLE @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.54 at MIL 4.00, with a projected total of 8.54. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.94 runs while MIL moved -0.48, changing the projected margin by +1.43 runs. The projected total climbed +0.49, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Brice Turang, William Contreras, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brayan Rocchio, Stuart Fairchild because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
